instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: MilestoneCove Evidence Release brief: The objective is to review grant milestone evidence and determine whether the next funded activity becomes eligible to proceed. The Grant Recipient submits milestone reports with completed activities and supporting evidence. The Program Monitor checks completeness and returns reports with missing required items. The Technical Reviewer records milestone achievement and adds comments. The Finance Checker records whether spending evidence supports the reported milestone. The Portfolio Lead marks the next activity eligible only when the milestone is achieved and the spending evidence supports it. Releasing grant payments and amending grant agreements are outside the project. The completeness checklist and accepted spending-evidence categories are still unknown.

output.business_objective: Review grant milestone evidence and determine whether the next funded activity becomes eligible to proceed.
